picks.headline: Anthropic Commits 5% of Shares to New Public Benefit Fund
picks.why: Anthropic is allocating 5% of its equity to fund public benefit initiatives as the lab scales.
picks.title: Investing in the public benefit

picks.headline: AWS and PyTorch Release TorchNeuron Native Backend for Trainium Chips
picks.why: Engineers can now run, compile, and profile PyTorch code natively on AWS Trainium2 and Trainium3 hardware.
picks.title: Introducing TorchNeuron: Native PyTorch backend for AWS Trainium

picks.headline: Meta Details Prometheus Supercluster Scaling Toward One Million GPUs
picks.why: Meta reveals architectural details of its gigawatt-scale New Albany supercluster used to train its Muse Wonder model.
picks.title: Inside Prometheus: Meta’s Journey to a Gigawatt-Scale Supercluster

picks.headline: Microsoft Expands Project Perception to Governance of Agentic Insiders
picks.why: Microsoft is building deterministic security controls to monitor and constrain non-deterministic autonomous AI agents in enterprise networks.
picks.title: Agents are your newest insiders. Security must move at their speed.

picks.headline: Authorization-Grounded Attack Exploits Token Approvals to Bypass Document Access Controls
picks.why: Demonstrates how tool-using agents can be tricked into abusing legitimate approval tokens without triggering explicit policy override detectors.
picks.title: When Approval Becomes Execution: Authorization-Grounded Workflow Attacks on Tool-Using Agents

picks.headline: Study Finds Low Prompt Injection Success in Small Agents Driven by Inattention
picks.why: Auditing 33,000 trajectories reveals open-weight agents frequently ignore indirect injections rather than actively blocking or refusing them.
picks.title: Ignored, Not Refused: What Low Prompt-Injection Success Rates Hide in Small Tool-Using Agents

picks.headline: Reasoning Models Obey Constraints Better When Placed in Internal Reasoning Channels
picks.why: Self-instructions embedded directly within a model's chain-of-thought steer output far more reliably than system or user prompt constraints.
picks.title: Reasoning Models Can Control Their Chains of Thought When They Tell Themselves To

papers.headline: Huginn Looped Transformer Architecture Reduces Resident Parameters by 75%
papers.why: Demonstrates a recurrent dynamic architecture that matches feedforward MoE FLOP efficiency while drastically cutting memory overhead.
papers.title: Towards Looped Models Done Right, Part I: Topology, Input Injection, Recurrent-State Design

papers.headline: Intra-Model Error Correlation Bottlenecks LLM Test-Time Compute Scaling
papers.why: Identifies why adding test-time compute to a single model hits diminishing returns and shows heterogeneous model arbitration fixes it.
papers.title: Not All Test-Time Compute Is Evidence: Model-Specific Bias in LLM Reasoning

papers.headline: Document Training Creates Transitive Behavioral Couplings in LLMs
papers.why: Explains how fine-tuning an LLM for a specific task unexpectedly induces non-targeted, multi-step composed behaviors.
papers.title: Behavioral Couplings: From Formation to Behavioral Emergence in Language Models
